newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bank seeks IPO, bourse entry in H2 1997.
newsitem.headline: Polish bank seeks IPO, bourse entry in H2 1997.

text.p: Polish medium-size Wschodni Bank Cukrownictwa SA wants to enter the Warsaw bourse in the second half of 1997 after a 10 million zloty initial public offering, the bank's president said on Thursday.

"We would like to carry out the issue in the second half of the year .... it would be an issue of at least 10 million zlotys ... and we hope we could enter the bourse before the year's end," Stanislaw Miedziak told Reuters. @

The bank, based in the eastern city of Lublin, had a net profit of 7.2 million zlotys last year on 90-million zloty revenue from interest. It expects its net profit to stay flat this year on 100-million-zloty revenue from interest.
The bank's current main shareholder is sugar refinery Lublin, which holds 20 percent in the bank.
